description.zh-CN: 生成融合自然植被、采光和未来建筑语言的中庭休息空间。
description.en-US: Visualize a curved modern atrium with greenery and a sunken circular lounge.

zh-CN.prompt: 创建一个宁静的未来感亲生物室内休息室，采用温暖的中性色调，位于一个 大型穹顶状中庭 内，顶部设有由三角形切面组成的几何玻璃木格栅屋顶。使用高角度广角建筑摄影视角，俯瞰圆形的下沉式休息区。空间具有流畅的有机建筑风格：浅色灰泥弧形墙壁、浅橡木垂直木镶板、圆润的坡道和分层的圆形挡土墙，右前方有一面醒目的赤陶色弧形墙壁。中心是一个圆形谈话坑，周围环绕着 3 张奶油色弧形组合沙发、2 张圆形奶油色脚凳咖啡桌、1 张小型圆形边桌，以及 4 个可见的柔和桃色、米色、橄榄色和棕褐色装饰靠垫。休息室周围环绕着茂密的绿色苔藓床和蕨类植物，分为 4 个种植区：一个大型左侧花园床、一个狭窄的后部苔藓床、一个小型抬高式后部花槽和一个右前方弧形花槽。营造宁静、舒适、奢华且与自然融合的氛围，天窗透出柔和的漫射日光，无人像，无文字，无杂物，超写实渲染，触感光滑的材质，柔和的阴影，建筑文摘风格，超广角构图，浅橡木和温暖灰泥，柔和赤陶色，宁静的避风港。

en-US.prompt: Create a serene biophilic architectural interior: a large sunken circular lounge inside a softly curved modern atrium, viewed from an elevated wide-angle perspective. The space has warm beige plaster walls, pale natural wood floors and wall panels, and a sweeping terracotta curved guard wall wrapping around the lounge. Above, a bright geometric glass-and-wood lattice roof spans the entire scene, made of repeating triangular beams with soft daylight filtering through. In the center is one circular conversation pit with exactly four curved cream upholstered sofa sections arranged around the perimeter, five visible accent pillows in muted clay, tan, olive, and cream tones, two round cream ottoman coffee tables in the middle, one small pale side table with a book on the left sofa edge, and one small pedestal side table near the back sofa. Surround the lounge with integrated indoor gardens: exactly five planted areas, including a large moss-and-fern bed on the left, a narrow moss bed behind the back sofa, a raised circular planter at the rear with ferns, a small round moss planter on the right, and a dense low green planting strip along the front edge. Add a wide curving ramp or walkway on the right leading behind the lounge, with tall seamless pale wood paneling and rounded architectural openings. Use a calming luxury spa aesthetic, organic architecture, soft indirect sunlight, creamy neutrals, earthy terracotta, lush moss greens, smooth rounded forms, no people, no visible text, no clutter. Render as a highly realistic architectural visualization, cinematic but peaceful, ultra-detailed materials, natural shadows, 16:9 horizontal composition. Customize the setting as serene biophilic organic modern atrium, main wall color as warm beige plaster, accent wall color as soft terracotta, greenery type as moss and ferns, and lighting mood as soft diffused daylight.
